💡 git-writer | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: A cross-platform note-taking application that uses Git for version control and synchronization of Markdown notes.
✨ Key Features: • Cross-platform support (Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS) • Git-backed note storage for version control and synchronization • Markdown note editing and rendering • Minimalistic user interface
📖 Summary: Git Writer is a minimalistic, cross-platform note-taking application that leverages Git repositories for version control and synchronization of Markdown notes across desktop and mobile devices. It aims to provide a seamless experience for managing notes across Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
